style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=4;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;" value="<b>Old pods</b> (t = 239s, ~30s style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=4;fontSize=11;fillColor=#f5f5f5;strokeColor=#999999;" value="<b>Kept for rollback</b><br>old ReplicaSet style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#666666;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="pr4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="pr-abort" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;whiteSpace=wrap;fontSize=11;fontColor=#333333;" value="<b>If a gate fails instead:</b> weights go back to 100 / 0 at once, the stable Service never div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 710px; margin-left: 32px;

display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
1 · readiness (/readyz, cached Postgres check)
not Ready → canary never receives weight
→ progressDeadlineAbort cancels the release
catches: bad config, dependency unreachable, crash

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 368px; height: 1px; padding-top: 710px; margin-left: 432px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
2 · Loki analysis (after 5%, 25%, 50%)
error rate of canary request logs > 2% twice → abort
→ weights back to 100% stable
catches: Ready but broken for users (logic bugs)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 338px; height: 1px; padding-top: 710px; margin-left: 832px;

div.div:
Legend
━━ traffic to stable ━━ traffic to canary
━━ request logs ━━ database dependency
┅┅ control: release, weights, analysis
Runs on 2× EC2 k3s from curated/01

div.div:
During canary (t = 11s → 142s)
stable Service → old ReplicaSet, 3/3, untouched
canary Service → new ReplicaSet,
scaled with the weight: 1 pod (5%, 25%), 2 (50%)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 268px; height: 1px; padding-top: 821px; margin-left: 332px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Promotion (t = 208s)
1. new ReplicaSet scaled to full size: 3/3
2. stable Service selector → new hash
3. weights back to 100 / 0
"stable" now means the new version

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 268px; height: 1px; padding-top: 821px; margin-left: 632px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Old pods (t = 239s, ~30s later)
old ReplicaSet scaled to 0 after
scaleDownDelaySeconds (default 30s),
so the gateway stops using them first;
each pod drains on SIGTERM (IX)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 238px; height: 1px; padding-top: 821px; margin-left: 932px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Kept for rollback
old ReplicaSet object stays at 0 replicas
(revisionHistoryLimit: 3): rolling back
scales it up again, no new image pull

div.div: If a gate fails instead: weights go back to 100 / 0 at once, the stable Service never moves, and the canary ReplicaSet is scaled to 0 after abortScaleDownDelaySeconds (Argo default 30s; not measured here). The old version never stopped serving.
